optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Insurance Policy Administration Migration

professionalSummary.text: Project manager for a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration over three years, owning migration plans and reconciliation schedules for three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly steering reports and presented reconciliation breaks to the steering committee, with committee minutes documenting questions and accepted explanations across 31 sessions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for each tranche and presented the reconciliation breaks to the steering committee; the committee minutes record the questions raised on each break and the explanations accepted across the thirty-one weekly sessions I presented.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed vendor and policy operations dependencies through the dependency log, escalating three vendor slips to the committee for resolution.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the platform vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log, taking three vendor slips to the committee for escalation.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared go-live readiness reviews with the steering committee's decision recorded, specifying ownership of checks between the project manager and policy operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the go-live readiness review for each tranche; the go-live decision was the steering committee's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were policy operations'.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote closure reports including project boundary statements and reconciliation evidence accepted by the finance controller.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each tranche with the project boundary statement and the reconciliation evidence accepted by the finance controller.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a migration plan with reconciliation schedule, committee minutes for two sessions, readiness review with committee decision, and closure report, verified by migration repository references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one migration plan with its reconciliation schedule, the committee minutes for two sessions, one readiness review with the committee's decision and one closure report, with the migration repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Reconciliation management, dependency log management, steering committee reporting, go-live readiness preparation, closure reporting.
skills.witness: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's ownership of migration plans and reconciliation schedules, preparation of steering reports with committee interaction, dependency log management, go-live readiness preparation with committee decision recording, and closure reporting with reconciliation evidence. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct experience with life and pensions policies or the specific legacy system being migrated.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to the need to verify the candidate's direct experience with life and pensions policies and the specific legacy system being migrated.

evidence.text: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.

evidence.text: Kept the platform vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log, taking three vendor slips to the committee for escalation.

evidence.text: Prepared the go-live readiness review for each tranche; the go-live decision was the steering committee's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were policy operations'.
evidence.notes: Confirms committee decision and ownership of checks.

evidence.text: Wrote the closure report for each tranche with the project boundary statement and the reconciliation evidence accepted by the finance controller.
evidence.notes: Directly states closure report content including reconciliation evidence.
